title: A podcast generated on CPU
description: One recorded AWS Batch run produced a four-turn, two-voice sample. This is an example from the application owner's experiment, not a benchmark of your project.

cleanup.scope: Recorded benchmark cleanup, not a check of the current project.

limitations: One short run does not establish a percentile, production throughput, a full-episode deadline or performance on Graviton.
